learning_objective: 🎯 Master the art of reading a long passage and extracting only the most important information using a structured, abbreviated format!

key_vocabulary.hindi_meaning: हाशिए से दूरी (पंक्ति की शुरुआत में जगह छोड़ना)

main_concepts.simple_explanation: First, read the passage quickly (skim) to understand the central theme. Then, read it carefully (scan) to underline the main ideas and supporting details.
Notes must never be written in complete sentences. Use short phrases. Ignore grammar words like 'is, am, are, the, a, an' to save time and space.
Notes must be structured logically. Main Heading -> Sub-heading (indented right) -> Sub-sub-heading (indented further right). This visual structure shows how ideas are connected.
You must use at least 4-5 abbreviations in your notes (e.g., 'govt.' for government, 'imp.' for important, '&' for and). Always provide a 'Key to Abbreviations' box at the end.
Always provide a short, catchy, and relevant title at the very top of your notes. It tells the reader what the entire passage is about.

fun_activity.title: ✂️ The Text Message Test
fun_activity.instructions: Take a 3-sentence paragraph from any textbook and rewrite it exactly like you would text a friend—using abbreviations, no grammar, and only the core message. You just made your first 'Note'!

exam_tips: 📌 You will lose marks if you do not draw a box for the 'Key to Abbreviations'.
📌 Do not invent symbols that no one understands. Use standard abbreviations (like govt., ed., w.r.t) or remove vowels to shorten words (e.g., 'mngmnt' for management).
📌 Numbering is crucial. Use consistent formats like 1, 1.1, 1.1.1 or I, A, a, i.
quick_recap: ⭐ The purpose of note-making is to save time during revision. Long texts are reduced to one-third of their size.
⭐ Titles should be written in the center at the top.
⭐ Never include your own opinions or outside information in the notes.
